blocks.text: Product Manager | Data, AI & Financial Platforms

Product Manager with ~3 years of direct PM-titled ownership (SaaS data platform + independent AI product delivery) built on a 15-year technical and financial-services foundation. Writes clear user stories and manages a tactical backlog end to end; ships AI-native, business-user-facing applications fast — most recently a task-oriented voting app built as a consumer-grade front end over a complex back-end, design-to-production in under two months, exactly the kind of packaged, non-technical experience Dataiku's Business Applications put in front of Business Experts. Holds Dataiku's own Generative AI Practitioner and Core Designer certifications. Comfortable translating data-science and platform concepts for both business experts and engineering teams.
